name: Strata Risk Advisory
description: Independent engineering-led contract-risk, project-risk, and pre-litigation technical advisory for high-value Saudi project exposure.

supportedInterfaces.description: Read-only public MCP endpoint for company overview, services, capabilities, scope matching, service areas, routing rules, and inquiry preparation.

skills.name: Get Company Overview
skills.description: Return Strata Risk Advisory public company information, positioning, legal boundary, and canonical resource links.

skills.name: List Services
skills.description: Return the public service mandate taxonomy for Strata's engineering-led Saudi project-risk advisory work.

skills.name: Match Project Scope
skills.description: Classify whether a request appears to fit Strata's high-value Saudi contract-risk, project-risk, or pre-litigation technical advisory scope.

skills.name: Prepare Project Inquiry
skills.description: Prepare a project inquiry draft for user review only; this skill does not submit forms, send email, or contact Strata.

skills.name: Screen Procurement Fit
skills.description: Help procurement agents classify Strata as an engineering-led advisory fit, possible fit, or non-fit before collecting or submitting inquiry details.

skills.name: List Service Areas
skills.description: Return public service-area and fit-signal information for Saudi-governed or Saudi-exposed project mandates.

skills.name: Read Public Resource
skills.description: Read one approved public resource such as company, services, capabilities, routing, OpenAPI, LLM, or MCP metadata.

allowed: Prepare a draft project inquiry for user review
Route non-fit requests away from the project inquiry form
not_allowed: Routing careers, vendors, training, retail, backlink, spam, or unrelated requests into project inquiry

public_resources.markdown_negotiation: Send Accept: text/markdown to canonical sitemap URLs such as https://www.stratasaudi.com/services
public_resources.markdown_sidecars: https://www.stratasaudi.com/{canonical-page}.md with https://www.stratasaudi.com/index.md for the home page; direct sidecars are noindex, follow

contact_policy: Email-only public intake through advisory@stratasaudi.com or https://www.stratasaudi.com/contact after explicit user approval.
